landing.faq1Q: How can a restaurant management software help my business?
landing.faq1A: It streamlines your daily operations by centralising QR ordering, the kitchen board and billing. With real-time data and smart tools, you reduce mistakes, engage guests and maximise revenue, all from a single system.
landing.faq2Q: What features does it offer compared to other software?
landing.faq2A: It's more than ordering software, it's a complete solution. It includes QR table ordering, a live kitchen board, offers and loyalty tools, and clear analytics to help you make informed decisions.
landing.faq3Q: Can I manage my restaurant remotely?
landing.faq3A: Yes! You can track orders, performance and tables from anywhere. Whether you're on-site or on the go, the mobile-friendly dashboard keeps you in control at all times.
landing.faq4Q: How does it improve table management?
landing.faq4A: QR codes on each table let guests order from their phones, which maximises seating efficiency, reduces wait times and boosts revenue effortlessly.
landing.faq5Q: Is it suitable for small and large restaurants?
landing.faq5A: Absolutely! Whether you run a small bistro or a multi-branch group, the platform scales to meet your needs, from independent eateries to busy dining rooms.
landing.faq6Q: How does it help me turn guests into loyal diners?
landing.faq6A: Building loyal guests is about great experiences and staying connected. You can create personalised offers and use your sales data to engage diners better.
landing.footerTagline: The friendly restaurant management system for Bangladesh.
landing.testimonial5Q: The QR ordering cut our order errors to nearly zero. Waiters spend less time writing orders and more time serving guests.
landing.testimonial6Q: Live order tracking means guests never wave us down asking where their food is. The dashboard pays for itself every single day.
